summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Claims Management and Satisfaction Trends features. Backend: 22/22 tests passed. Frontend: All features verified working. Fixed 1 critical bug in ClaimsView.jsx (SelectItem empty value error).

ui_bugs.issue: SelectItem with empty string value causing runtime error
